einzeiler: The CIA ran secret LSD safe houses to test mind control during the Cold War.
kurzfassung: Operation Midnight Climax was a CIA-backed program where agents secretly dosed unwitting citizens with LSD using safe houses in San Francisco and New York. Led by chemist Sidney Gottlieb and narcotics officer George White, the project aimed to explore mind control methods under the umbrella of MK-Ultra. Despite causing severe psychological damage and at least one suspicious death among scientists, the program operated for a decade before files were ordered destroyed.
stichpunkte: Cold War fears of enemy brainwashing inspired the CIA to launch the MK-Ultra mind control program.
Chemist Sidney Gottlieb oversaw chemical research and personally developed poisons for potential foreign assassinations.
The CIA hired stage magician John Mulholland to write a manual on sleight of hand for covertly drugging targets.
Narcotics agent George White managed safe houses in Greenwich Village and San Francisco to test LSD on unwitting civilians.
Sex workers were hired to lure men into the San Francisco apartment where agents watched and recorded them through two-way mirrors.
Biological weapons scientist Frank Olson was secretly dosed with LSD and died after falling from a hotel window days later.
Deputy U.S. marshal Wayne Richie believed he was unwittingly drugged at a holiday party, leading to a botched robbery and career ruin.
Most MK-Ultra files were shredded in 1973, but surviving documents and 1975 congressional investigations finally exposed the program.

clips.text: Operatives utilized state budgets to compensate local sex workers for luring targets into a monitored environment where their beverages were secretly adulterated.

beschreibung:
In the 1950s and 60s, at the height of the Cold War, the CIA launched a secret program called Operation Midnight Climax as part of its notorious MKUltra mind-control research. Operating out of safehouses in San Francisco and New York, agents used sex workers to lure unwitting men, then dosed them with LSD without their knowledge and observed the results through one-way mirrors. The goal was to study whether psychedelics could be weaponized for interrogation, coercion, and control. What unfolded was a chilling abuse of government power, hidden from the public for decades until investigations finally exposed it. In this episode of Conspiracy Theories, Cults, & Crimes, Vanessa Richardson investigates Operation Midnight Climax, the Cold War paranoia that drove the CIA to experiment on its own citizens, and the disturbing legacy of a program that treated unsuspecting people as test subjects in the search for a mind-control weapon.
